stacking.note: No hardware stacking. Cloud-managed via the Meter dashboard / Meter Network Operating System. Typical designs pair S3 as a small site core with S1/S2 access

routing.summary: Marketed as a core switch. Published hardware specs are Layer 2 (VLANs up to 4096). Dynamic routing is not listed on the switch; Meter gateways/firewalls handle routed services

power.summary: Single fixed internal AC PSU (100-240V; ~1.7A at 115V)

redundancy.detail: Fixed internal PSU; no redundant option listed

licensing: Included with Meter Network as a Service. Hardware is provisioned and managed as part of the Meter subscription rather than sold as standalone switches with a separate license SKU
verifyNote: Confirm whether any Layer 3 features run on the S3 itself versus only on Meter gateways. Buffer listed as 3M bits on the sheet; treated as 3 MB to match S1

models.note: 6x 1/10/25G SFP28 + 6x 1/10G SFP+. 1x console + 1x 1G RJ-45 OOB. Silent under normal operating conditions. MTBF 1M hours. 1U full width
